item.title: Fails to provide input parameters for VS code tasks
item.body:
Type: Bug I have a VS code task that requires Copilot to provide input parameters. It fails to do so, instead VS code pops up a dialog asking me to provide this input. ```json { "version": "2.0.0", "tasks": [ { "type": "process", "command": "just", "args": [ "package=${input:package}", "build", ], "problemMatcher": [ "$rustc" ], "group": { "kind": "build", "isDefault": true }, "label": "just: build" }, { "type": "process", "command": "just", "args": [ "package=${input:package}", "test", ], "problemMatcher": [ "$rustc" ], "group": { "kind": "test", "isDefault": true }, "label": "just: test" }, { "type": "process", "command": "just", "args": [ "package=${input:package}", "test-docs" ], "problemMatcher": [ "$rustc" ], "group": { "kind": "test" }, "label": "just: test-docs" }, { "type": "process", "command": "just", "args": [ "package=${input:package}", "docs" ], "problemMatcher": [ "$rustc" ], "group": "none", "label": "just: docs" }, { "type": "process", "command": "just", "args": [ "package=${input:package}", "bench" ], "problemMatcher": [ "$rustc" ], "group": "none", "label": "just: bench" }, ], "inputs": [ { "id": "package", "description": "Rust package (default = all)", "default": "", "type": "pickString", "options": [ "", "benchmark_utils", "benchmarks", "cpulist", "folo_ffi", "folo_utils", "linked", "linked_macros", "linked_macros_impl", "many_cpus", "many_cpus_benchmarking", "new_zealand", "nm", "pinned_pool", "region_cached", "region_local", "testing" ] } ] } ``` Extension version: 0.28.1 VS Code version: Code 1.101.1 (18e3a1ec544e6907be1e944a94c496e302073435, 2025-06-18T13:35:12.605Z) OS version: Windows_NT x64 10.0.26100 Modes:
